Protocols 5, 6, 7: The Commander's Burden
Personal Participation
Everyone from the township chairman to the commander-
in-chief must personally undertake investigation.
Warning: Reading reports is entirely different from investigating.
Probe Deeply
Novices must make one or two thoroush investigations of
a specific place (a village) or problem (currency) first.
This baseline makes future investigations easier.
Make Your Own Notes
The investigator must preside, guide, and record.
Warning: To have others do it for you is no good.
